d.ko: Enter a house where every clue feels wrong. Investigate a brutal crime scene, uncover hidden evidence, and use your detective tools to piece together a disturbing truth buried beneath the silence.
d.en: Enter a house where every clue feels wrong. Investigate a brutal crime scene, uncover hidden evidence, and use your detective tools to piece together a disturbing truth buried beneath the silence.
d.zh: 进入一栋每条线索都透着诡异的房子。调查一处残忍的犯罪现场，揭开隐藏的证据，并使用你的侦探工具，拼凑出埋藏在寂静之下的骇人真相。
